lines: Do you know Seok Hopil? ⓐ<u>His English name was Frank W. Schofield, but he loved his Korean name.</u> ⓑ<u>It sounded similarly to his real name</u>, and it also had a good meaning.

Dr. Schofield was a Canadian doctor, and ⓒ<u>he first came to Korea in 1916 for teach medicine</u>. He wanted to teach in Korean. __(A)__, he began to learn Korean right away. ⓓ<u>He studied very hard that he was able to teach in Korean</u> after only a few years. He believed that every country has the right to be independent, ⓔ<u>so he helps the Korean independence movement</u>.

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름상 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: So
However
Therefore
As a result
Consequently
items.explain: 앞 문장이 원인(한국어로 가르치고 싶었다), 뒤가 결과(한국어를 배우기 시작했다)이므로 결과의 연결어가 온다. However(그러나)는 흐름에 맞지 않는다. 원문은 ‘..., so he began ...’.
items.source: L6 본문 4문단

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
items.explain: ⓑ sound + 형용사: similarly → similar / ⓒ 목적을 나타내는 to부정사: for teach → to teach / ⓓ so ~ that 구문: very hard that → so hard that / ⓔ 과거 시제: helps → helped. ⓐ는 원문 그대로 옳다.
items.source: L6 본문 3~4문단 · 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR so ~ that

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름상 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 단어로 알맞은 것은?
items.box: It sounded similar __(B)__ his real name, and it also had a good meaning.
choices: to
of
for
with
about
items.explain: similar to: ~와 비슷한.
items.source: L6 본문 3문단 · L6 어휘 similar to

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 대답을 찾을 수 없는 질문은?
choices: When did Dr. Schofield first come to Korea?
Why did Dr. Schofield begin to learn Korean?
What did Dr. Schofield want to teach?
What language did Dr. Schofield want to teach in?
How many articles did Dr. Schofield write for Korea's independence?
items.explain: 기사를 몇 편 썼는지는 글에 없다. ① 1916년 ② 한국어로 가르치고 싶어서 ③ 의학(medicine) ④ 한국어(Korean). 질문은 통합본 L6 본문 문제의 것 그대로.
items.source: L6 본문 3~4문단 · 통합본 L6 READING 질문

items.stem: <보기>의 (A)~(E)를 윗글에서 일어난 일의 순서로 바르게 배열한 것은?

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: (A) He was able to teach in Korean.
(B) He came to Korea to teach medicine.
(C) He began to learn Korean.
(D) He helped the Korean independence movement.
(E) He wanted to teach in Korean.

items.explain: 1916년 한국에 옴 → 한국어로 가르치고 싶어 함 → 한국어를 배우기 시작 → 몇 년 만에 한국어로 가르침 → 독립운동을 도움. 보기 문장은 본문을 요약해 바꿔 쓴 것.
items.source: L6 본문 4문단

lines: The final stop of our tour today is Muswell Hill. Can't see any street artworks? Well, look ⓐ[down / up] and look closely. (A) Do you see the little chewing gum paintings? (B) Wilson is well known for painting pictures on gum that people drop on the street. (C) His gum paintings often carry ⓑ[social / personal] messages from people he meets on the street. (D) For example, the one over here is a happy birthday wish for a loved one. (E) Wilson's gum paintings are ⓒ[tiny / huge], but they give great pleasure to many people.

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름상 다음 문장이 들어갈 가장 적절한 곳은?
items.box: They are by the artist Ben Wilson.
items.explain: They = the little chewing gum paintings. 껌 그림을 가리킨 뒤, 그 작가가 Wilson임을 밝히고 이어서 Wilson을 설명한다.
items.source: L5 본문 3문단

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름상 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
items.explain: 바닥의 껌이므로 look down / 생일 축하처럼 개인적인 메시지 personal / 작지만(tiny) 큰 기쁨을 준다.
items.source: L5 본문 3문단

items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
choices: Here are the presents <u>that</u> we sent you.
The medicine <u>that</u> doctors developed reduces pain quickly.
I was so hungry <u>that</u> I ate the whole cake.
The website <u>that</u> my cousin designed provides useful information.
I want to know the name of the boy <u>that</u> I met yesterday.
items.explain: ③은 so ~ that 구문의 접속사 that. 나머지는 목적격 관계대명사 that.
items.source: 학습지 p.6 Practice A-1·5, C-4·12 · 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR so ~ that

lines: Hello, everyone. The movie I'm going to introduce today is The Song of Love. (A) <u>It's a movie about a pianist who loses his love for music.</u> He moves to a small town for a new start. There, he begins teaching music to children and finds his love for music again. This movie has great music and a touching story, so I strongly recommend it.

items.stem: 윗글의 맥락상 밑줄 친 (A)에서 추론할 수 있는 피아니스트의 심경으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: excited
pleased
unhappy
proud
relaxed
items.explain: 음악에 대한 사랑을 잃어버린 상태이므로 unhappy(불행한). 뒤에서 새 출발을 위해 이사하는 것과 이어진다.
items.source: L6 Listen Up

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
choices: The speaker is introducing the movie The Song of Love.
A pianist loses his love for music.
He moves to a small town for a new start.
There, he begins teaching music to children.
The pianist never finds his love for music again.
items.explain: finds his love for music again — 음악에 대한 사랑을 되찾는다. ②는 통합본 영화 소개 메모, ③④는 본문 문장 그대로.
items.source: L6 Listen Up · 통합본 L6 Listen Up 메모

lines: Kim Mandeok was born in Jeju-do in 1739. She was a successful businesswoman. In 1795, she saw many people dying from hunger. So, she bought rice with all her money and gave it away to poor people. Her love for others was so <u>selfless</u> that many people respected her. From her life, I learned that selfless love for others can make a big difference.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 selfless의 영영풀이로 옳은 것은?
choices: making you feel sad or emotional
important in history
to come together in a group in one place
a thing that you do to help somebody
caring more about other people's needs and interests than about your own
items.explain: selfless(이타적인): 자신보다 다른 사람들의 필요와 관심사에 더 마음을 쓰는. ① touching ② historic ③ gather ④ favor.
items.source: L6 Think and Write · L6 어휘 영영풀이

items.stem: 다음 중 윗글의 Kim Mandeok처럼 다른 사람을 도운 사람에 대한 문장이 아닌 것은?
choices: Nick Priest saw a car accident and ran to save the children on the bus.
Kay Brown saw a homeless person in the subway and gave her own shoes to her.
Eliot Middleton spends his free time fixing old cars and donating them to people in need.
Audrey Hepburn did a lot of volunteer work, especially for children.
My aunt ran a Thai restaurant before, and she still runs it now.
items.explain: ①②③은 L6 Culture Project, ④는 L6 Watch and Talk C(She did a lot of volunteer work, especially for children.)의 사람들로 모두 남을 도왔다. ⑤(학습지 p.4 Practice C-9)는 식당을 운영한다는 말일 뿐 남을 도운 이야기가 아니다.
items.source: L6 Think and Write · L6 Culture Project · L6 Watch and Talk C · 학습지 p.4 Practice C-9

items.stem: 다음 문장들의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어는?
items.box:
○ According _____ STIK, the three figures represent the past, present, and future of Shoreditch.
○ It sounded similar _____ his real name, and it also had a good meaning.
choices: to
at
in
on
of
items.explain: according to(~에 따르면), similar to(~와 비슷한).
items.source: L5 본문 1문단 · L6 본문 3문단 · 어휘 리스트

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: Some fish used to live on land a long time ago.
He used to be shy, but now he is very outgoing.
Did she use to work at that company before she moved here?
My family used to go camping every summer, but we don't go anymore.
They don't use to eat vegetables, but they are trying to stay healthy now.
items.explain: used to의 부정문은 didn't use to + 동사원형. don't use to → didn't use to.
items.source: 학습지 p.4 Practice C-2·3·4·6·10

lines: We are now in Finsbury Park to see a painting by Banksy, an internationally famous street artist. Banksy's artworks often carry social messages, and the green tree you see over there is a good example. As you can see, he created a green tree by spraying green paint on a wall behind a leafless tree. Next to the tree, there is a person who is holding a sprayer. What message does Banksy want to give us through this painting? In many people's opinion, he is telling us that nature is having a hard time. They think he wants us to take better care of it.

items.stem: 윗글로 보아, Banksy의 그림에 담긴 메시지를 많은 사람들이 어떻게 생각하는지 가장 잘 나타낸 것은?
choices: Modern street art makes cities colorful and lively.
We should take better care of nature.
Shoreditch is now one of the trendiest areas in London.
Wilson's artworks carry messages about social problems.
People are working together to create the artworks.
items.explain: They think he wants us to take better care of it(nature). 통합본 L6 본문 문제의 답 문장 We should take better care of nature. 나머지는 STIK·Wilson·Culture Project 문장(①③④⑤).
items.source: L5 본문 2문단 · 통합본 L5 READING T/F·서술형 문장

items.stem: 윗글을 다음과 같이 요약하고자 할 때, 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
items.box: Banksy made the green tree by ⓐ___ paint on a wall behind a ⓑ___ tree. Many people think the painting suggests we should ⓒ___ more about nature.
items.explain: spraying green paint / a leafless tree / care more about nature(= take better care of it). 요약문은 통합본 L5 본문 T/F 문장 두 개를 그대로 썼다.
items.source: L5 본문 2문단 · 통합본 L5 READING T/F 12·14

lines: On March 1, 1919, (가) <u>Schofield 박사는 탑골공원에서 사람들이 한국의 독립을 외치는 소리를 들었다.</u> He took pictures of the event with his camera. He then wrote an article about the historic event and sent it to foreign newspapers with his pictures.

Dr. Schofield's fight for Korean independence didn't stop even after the March 1st Movement. He continued to write about the terrible situation in Korea for foreign newspapers. He was under the watchful eye of the Japanese police, so he had to go back to Canada in 1920.

In 1958, he returned to Korea at the invitation of the Korean government and never left again. For the rest of his life, he worked hard to help Koreans, especially poor students. Dr. Schofield died in April 1970, and he was buried in Seoul National Cemetery.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Dr. Schofield wrote an article and sent it to Korean newspapers.
Dr. Schofield stopped supporting Korean independence after the March 1st Movement.
Because the Japanese police were watching him, Dr. Schofield returned to Canada in 1920.
Dr. Schofield left Korea again after a few years.
Dr. Schofield helped only Korean students for the rest of his life.
items.explain: ① foreign newspapers ② didn't stop ④ never left again ⑤ Koreans, especially poor students. 선지는 통합본 L6 본문 T/F 문장 그대로.
items.source: L6 본문 5~7문단 · 통합본 L6 READING T/F 15~20

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 Dr. Schofield에 대해 바르게 이해한 학생은?
choices: S 1: "He took pictures of the event with his phone."
S 2: "He continued to write about the terrible situation in Korea for foreign newspapers."
S 3: "He had to go back to Canada in 1958."
S 4: "He returned to Korea at the invitation of the Japanese government."
S 5: "He worked hard to help Koreans, especially rich students."
items.explain: ② 본문 문장 그대로. ① with his camera ③ in 1920 ④ the Korean government ⑤ poor students — 본문 문장에서 한 단어씩 바꾼 것.
items.source: L6 본문 5~7문단

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (가)를 <조건>에 맞춰 바르게 영작하시오.
condition: 다음 단어를 반드시 사용할 것 (※ 단, 필요시 단어의 형태를 변형할 것): hear, shout, Korean independence, Tapgol Park
items.answer: Dr. Schofield heard people shouting for Korean independence in Tapgol Park.
items.explain: 지각동사 hear + 목적어 + -ing(현재분사). 10단어.
items.source: L6 본문 5문단 · 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR 지각동사

items.stem: 다음 문장들의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 단어가 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
items.box:
○ Take line 4, the green line, and get off ⓐ___ Hangang Station.
○ Next ⓑ___ the tree, there is a person who is holding a sprayer.
○ Dr. Schofield died in April 1970, and he was buried ⓒ___ Seoul National Cemetery.
items.explain: get off at ~(~에서 내리다), next to(~ 옆에), be buried in(~에 묻히다).
items.source: L5 Watch and Talk A-1 · L5 본문 2문단 · L6 본문 7문단

items.stem: 다음 대화에서 A, B의 관계로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
A: What kinds of magazines do you have?
B: We have all kinds of magazines.
A: I'm really interested in science. Can you recommend a science magazine for me?
B: Sure. You'll love this one, Teen's Science.
items.explain: 잡지를 찾는 손님(customer)과 잡지를 파는 점원(clerk).
items.source: L6 Watch and Talk A-4

lines: B: Somi, I need help. <u>여기에서 세빛 공원으로 가는 가장 좋은 방법이 뭐니?</u>
G: Sebit Park? Well, you can get there by bus or by subway, but the subway is better.
B: OK. Which line should I take?
G: Take line 3, and get off at Sebit Station.
B: Line 3 and get off at Sebit Station. How long will it take?
G: It'll take about 40 minutes.
B: Is it that far?
G: Yes. Anyway, why are you going to Sebit Park, Liam?
B: Oh, there is an art fair this Saturday. You can come with me if you want.
G: Really? I'm free this Saturday. Let's go together.
B: Perfect. Let's meet here at 10.

items.stem: 다음은 Liam이 대화 후에 적은 메모이다. 위 대화의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

box.title: To Sebit Park
lines: ① The subway is recommended as the better way to reach Sebit Park.
② The park is about 40 minutes away by subway.
③ I need to take line 3 and get off at Sebit Station to get there.
④ There is an art fair this Sunday.
⑤ Somi: I'm free this Saturday. Let's go together.

choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
items.explain: 미술 박람회는 this Saturday(토요일). 메모 문장은 대화문·통합본 L5 대화 요약문 그대로, ④만 Saturday → Sunday. 그림·표 대신 메모 글로 물었다.
items.source: L5 Watch and Talk C · 통합본 L5 DIALOGUES 요약문

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 우리말을 <조건>에 맞춰 바르게 영작하시오.
condition: 다음 단어를 반드시 사용할 것: what, the best way, get to, from here
총 11단어인 문장을 작성할 것 (What's는 한 단어로 센다)
items.answer: What's the best way to get to Sebit Park from here?
items.explain: 가장 좋은 방법을 묻는 표현 What's the best way to get to ~? 11단어.
items.source: L5 Watch and Talk C

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: I hear birds singing every morning.
I felt someone touch my shoulder.
The movie was so sad that everyone cried.
She is so tall that she can reach the shelf.
I saw a man to run down the street.
items.explain: 지각동사 see의 목적격 보어는 동사원형 또는 현재분사: to run → run / running.
items.source: 통합본 L6 GRAMMAR 지각동사 · so ~ that

items.stem: 다음 중 우리말 영작이 바르지 않은 것은?
choices:
그녀가 온라인에서 산 책들은 비싸지 않다.
→ The books which she bought online aren't expensive.

그녀는 할머니가 그녀에게 주신 드레스를 입었다.
→ She wore the dress which her grandmother gave her.

내가 점심으로 먹은 스파게티는 정말 형편없었다.
→ The spaghetti which I ate it for lunch was really terrible.

내가 어제 만난 학생은 답을 모른다.
→ The student whom I met yesterday doesn't know the answer.

너는 네 친구가 추천한 그 앱을 사용할 거니?
→ Will you use the app which your friend recommended?
items.explain: 목적격 관계대명사 which가 ate의 목적어이므로 뒤에 it을 다시 쓰지 않는다.
items.source: 학습지 p.6 Practice B-1·2·3·6·7

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The chef whom I met him at the cooking contest shared his secret recipe.
Did you watch the movie about that everyone was talking?
The hotel at which we stayed during our trip had a great pool.
Do you have the email address of the designer with who we worked last project?
The law that the government introduced protect endangered animals.
items.explain: ① him 삭제 ② about that → about which(전치사 뒤에는 that 불가) ④ with who → with whom ⑤ 주어 The law에 맞춰 protects. ③ 전치사 + which 형태가 옳다.
items.source: 학습지 p.6 Practice C-2·3·6·9·10

items.stem: 다음 대화의 밑줄 친 남자(Man)의 우리말을 <조건>에 맞춰 바르게 영작하시오.
items.box:
Man: Dr. Schofield, I have a special favor to ask you.
Dr. Schofield: What can I do for you?
Man: <u>내일 한국의 독립을 위해 많은 사람들이 모일 예정입니다.</u> Could you take pictures of the event and share them with the world?
condition: 다음 단어를 반드시 사용할 것: many people, be going to, gather, the independence of Korea
items.answer: Many people are going to gather tomorrow for the independence of Korea.
items.explain: be going to + 동사원형, gather(모이다), for the independence of Korea. 12단어.
items.source: L6 본문 1문단

items.stem: <보기>와 같이 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 완성하시오.

box.title: < 보 기 >
lines: The book was very interesting. + I read it yesterday.
⇨ The book which I read yesterday was very interesting.
I like the dress. + Emma is wearing it.

items.answer: I like the dress which[that] Emma is wearing.
items.explain: 목적격 관계대명사 which/that(목적어 it을 대신). 관계대명사 생략도 가능.
items.source: 학습지 p.5 목적어의 종류 · 통합본 L5 GRAMMAR 목적격 관계대명사
